notes.title: Release date announced!
notes.notes:
Greetings, The Fridge is Red seekers!

We have very cool news for you today, as the release date for The Fridge is Red full game has been revealed!

But before we talk about that, you should know that the full version of the game will include 6 chilling episodes set in different environments and unsettling liminal spaces!

Watch the Announcement Date Reveal Trailer
[previewyoutube=eCxTRQjAluQ;full][/previewyoutube]

That's right, thrill seekers! Wishlist the game, share the news with everyone you know and get ready for September 27! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532460/
